name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - Après le considérant J - Am 1
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: Ja. whereas the UK has had a determining role in defining the principles of freedom of speech and resistance to censorship that underpin modern democracies; whereas recent developments suggest a worrying departure from its long tradition of safeguarding open debate; whereas the arrest and imprisonment of ordinary citizens for online comments criticising government migration and security policies raises serious concerns about the proportionality of state action;
